title: Shri Balaji Cricket Academy Website - Frontend Implementation

requirements.summary: Create a Hero section with academy name, tagline, and call-to-action button
acceptanceCriteria: Academy name 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy' is prominently displayed in the hero section
A tagline is visible below the academy name
A call-to-action button (e.g., 'Enroll Now' or 'Get Started') is present and scrolls to the contact/enquiry form

file_operations.description: Create a Hero component featuring the academy name 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy', a compelling tagline, and a call-to-action button that scrolls to the contact form. Use the generated hero banner image at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-banner.dim_1400x600.png as the background. Apply deep green and gold color palette with strong typography for the heading. Include smooth scroll behavior for the CTA button.
Import and render the HeroSection component at the top of the main application layout. Ensure it is the first visible section on the homepage.

requirements.summary: Create an About Us section describing the academy's mission and coaching philosophy
acceptanceCriteria: About Us section is present on the page
Section includes text about the academy's mission and coaching philosophy
Section is visually distinct and easy to read

file_operations.description: Create an AboutSection component with content describing the academy's mission to nurture young cricket talent and the coaching philosophy. Use a visually distinct layout with consistent cricket-themed styling (deep green and gold colors). Ensure the text is well-structured and readable.
Import and render the AboutSection component below the HeroSection. Add an id attribute 'about' to enable smooth scrolling from navigation.

requirements.summary: Create a Coaching Programs section highlighting programs with minimum age requirement of 7 years
acceptanceCriteria: Coaching Programs section is present on the page
Minimum age of 7 years is explicitly mentioned
Program cards or list items display key features and benefits
Section is clearly organized and easy to scan

file_operations.description: Create a ProgramsSection component displaying available coaching programs. Clearly state the minimum enrollment age of 7 years in prominent text. Display program benefits and features in an organized card-based or list layout. Use cricket-themed styling consistent with the overall design. Ensure the section is scannable and visually engaging.
Import and render the ProgramsSection component below the AboutSection. Add an id attribute 'programs' for smooth scrolling navigation.

requirements.summary: Create a Gallery section displaying cricket academy activity images in a responsive grid
acceptanceCriteria: Gallery section is present on the page
Images are displayed in a responsive grid layout
Section has a clear heading such as 'Gallery' or 'Our Academy in Action'

file_operations.description: Create a GallerySection component displaying a responsive grid of cricket academy images. Use the generated gallery images: frontend/public/assets/generated/gallery-1.dim_600x400.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/gallery-2.dim_600x400.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/gallery-3.dim_600x400.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/gallery-4.dim_600x400.png, frontend/public/assets/generated/gallery-5.dim_600x400.png, and frontend/public/assets/generated/gallery-6.dim_600x400.png. Include a clear heading like 'Gallery' or 'Our Academy in Action'. Ensure the grid is responsive and adapts to different screen sizes.
Import and render the GallerySection component below the ProgramsSection. Add an id attribute 'gallery' for navigation purposes.

requirements.summary: Create a Contact/Enquiry section with form for parents to submit enquiry data to the backend
acceptanceCriteria: Contact form includes fields: child's name, parent's name, phone number, child's age, and message
Form validates that the child's age is 7 or above
On submission, the enquiry data is saved in the backend
A success confirmation message is shown after successful submission
Academy contact details (phone, address placeholder) are shown alongside the form

file_operations.description: Create a ContactSection component with a form containing fields for child's name, parent's name, phone number, child's age, and message. Implement validation to ensure child's age is 7 or above. On form submission, call the backend.submitContactForm method from the backend interface with the form data. Display a success message upon successful submission. Include academy contact details (placeholder phone and address) alongside the form. Handle loading and error states appropriately.
Import and render the ContactSection component below the GallerySection. Add an id attribute 'contact' to enable smooth scrolling from the hero CTA and navigation bar.

requirements.summary: Create a sticky navigation bar with smooth-scrolling links to all sections
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation bar is sticky and visible on scroll
All section links are present and scroll smoothly to their respective sections
Academy name or logo is displayed in the navbar
Navigation is responsive and collapses appropriately on mobile screens

file_operations.description: Create a Navbar component with a sticky position that remains visible on scroll. Include navigation links to Home, About, Programs, Gallery, and Contact sections with smooth-scrolling behavior. Display the academy logo from frontend/public/assets/generated/academy-logo.dim_200x200.png and/or the academy name 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy'. Implement responsive design with a mobile-friendly collapsed menu. Use the cricket-themed color palette (deep green and gold).
Import and render the Navbar component at the top of the application layout above all sections. Ensure it remains sticky across all scroll positions.

requirements.summary: Apply a bold cricket-themed visual design with deep green and gold colors throughout the site
acceptanceCriteria: Deep green and gold are the dominant brand colors used throughout the site
Headings use a strong, prominent typography style
Visual theme is consistent across all sections
Overall design feels professional and suitable for a sports coaching academy

file_operations.description: Update global CSS to define the cricket-themed color palette with deep green and gold as primary brand colors. Set strong, bold typography styles for headings using serif or display fonts. Define consistent spacing, borders, and visual elements that create a professional sports academy aesthetic. Ensure the theme is enforced globally across all components.

Extend Tailwind configuration to include custom deep green and gold color values in the theme palette. Define custom typography settings for headings to use strong, prominent font styles. Add any custom spacing or design tokens needed to support the cricket-themed visual design consistently.
